questions.question: What kinds of laws does chapter 21 contain?
options: Instructions for keeping the three great yearly pilgrim festivals
Social laws: unsolved murder, captives, inheritance, a rebellious son
Rules for waging war and for dividing the spoil taken from enemies
Laws for offering the daily sacrifices and the grain gifts at the altar
questions.answer: Social laws: unsolved murder, captives, inheritance, a rebellious son

questions.question: What did the law say about a body hanged on a tree?
options: Display it at the gate as a warning
Burn it outside the camp with fire
Leave it hanging until the next sunrise
Bury it the same day, for it is cursed by God
questions.answer: Bury it the same day, for it is cursed by God
